info.title: Tripz Backend API
info.description:
Multi-panel travel-marketplace backend exposing Super Admin, Admin, Vendor, Client, and Marketplace surfaces.

**Response envelope** — every endpoint returns:
- Success: `{ success: true, message: string, data: object | null }`
- Error: `{ success: false, message: string, errors: object | array | null }`

**Auth** — all authenticated endpoints expect a JWT access token via `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Refresh tokens are delivered as an httpOnly cookie (web) and also in the JSON body (mobile / API clients).

**Account states** — vendors who submit KYC are immediately deactivated (`isActive=false`) and only re-activated when an admin approves or rejects their KYC. Login & refresh return `code: ACCOUNT_UNDER_REVIEW` while pending.

**Role values (public API contract)** — `CLIENT` (customer) and `VENDOR` (agent). These match the internal Prisma enum directly.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, token rotation, profile, OTP-based email verification & password reset

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Generic file uploads to Cloudinary (images + PDFs)

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Endpoints available to SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN roles

post.summary: Register a new account (CLIENT or VENDOR)
post.description:
Single endpoint for self-signup. `role: "CLIENT"` for customers, `role: "VENDOR"` for travel agents. `ADMIN` and `SUPER_ADMIN` cannot self-register.

Account is created with `emailVerifiedAt = null`. An OTP is emailed. **No tokens are issued** — call `/auth/verify-email` then `/auth/login`. Response includes an `otp` metadata block so the frontend can render countdown + resend cooldown.

example.message: Account registered. Please verify your email to continue.
An account with this email already exists.

post.summary: Email + password login
post.description:
Returns access (15 min) and refresh (7 days) tokens. Refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie AND included in the JSON body.

Failure codes: `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (also re-sends OTP), `ACCOUNT_UNDER_REVIEW` (vendor KYC pending admin), `ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED` (admin disabled).

value.message: Email not verified. We have sent a new verification code to your inbox.
Your application is under review. We will email you once your account is approved.
This account has been deactivated. Please contact support.

post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with Google ID token
post.description:
- Existing Google account → log in (`isNewAccount: false`, 200)
- Existing email but no Google link → auto-link (provider → HYBRID), log in
- Brand new → `role` required (`CLIENT` or `VENDOR`), creates + logs in (201)

201.description: New account created and signed in

400.description: Missing role on first-time signup, or invalid token

post.summary: Rotate refresh + access tokens
post.description: Refresh token read from httpOnly cookie OR JSON body. BOTH tokens are rotated. Replay attempts trigger revocation of ALL the user's refresh tokens.

401.description: Refresh token invalid / expired / revoked / replayed

403.description: Account state blocks refresh — same codes as `/login`: `ACCOUNT_UNDER_REVIEW`, `ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED`

post.summary: Revoke refresh token + clear cookie
post.description: Idempotent — succeeds even with no token presented.

post.summary: Verify email with OTP
post.description: Consumes the latest active OTP. After verification, user must call `/auth/login` separately — no tokens issued here.

401.description: Invalid OTP, expired, exhausted attempts, or unknown email

post.summary: Resend email verification OTP
post.description: Generic-shape response (does not reveal account existence). Subject to `OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` rate limit. Always returns `otp` metadata for countdown rendering.

200.description: Generic response (whether email exists or not)

example.message: If an account exists for that email, a verification code has been sent.
Please wait 45s before requesting another code.

post.summary: Step 1 of password reset — request OTP
post.description: Sends an OTP email if the account exists. Generic response prevents account enumeration. Anti-spam cooldown applies. Includes `otp` metadata for countdown.

post.summary: Step 2 of password reset — verify OTP without consuming it
post.description:
Validates the OTP from step 1 but does NOT consume it. Use to let the user move from the OTP screen to the password screen with confidence. The OTP must still be re-validated AND will be consumed by step 3 (`/password/reset`).

Failed attempts increment the rate-limit counter; exhausted OTPs are burned.

example.message: OTP verified. You can now set a new password.

401.description: Wrong OTP, expired, exhausted attempts, or unknown email

post.summary: Step 3 of password reset — set new password
post.description:
Re-validates the OTP, hashes the new password, updates the user, revokes ALL refresh tokens (kicks out any attacker), consumes the OTP, sends a 'password changed' notice email.

Can be called as step 2 (skipping verify-otp) — useful if you want the combined single-screen UX.

401.description: Invalid OTP, expired, or exhausted attempts

post.summary: Upload an image or PDF to Cloudinary
post.description:
Authenticated upload. Files stored under `tripz/<purpose>/<userId>/<name-or-timestamp>`. Backend returns the public CDN URL — does NOT touch the database.

If `name` is provided, the file is saved at that stable slot name (re-uploads with the same name overwrite the previous file). If `name` is omitted, a timestamped filename is used (each upload preserved).

file.description: Max 5 MB. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf.

name.description: Optional. Stable slot name (a-z, 0-9, -, _ only). Re-uploads with the same name replace the previous file.

post.summary: Submit a travel-inquiry lead (public, no auth required)
post.description:
Public endpoint accepting anonymous form submissions. If a valid Bearer token is sent, the lead is linked to the authenticated customer; otherwise `customerUserId = null`.

**Hybrid storage**: `destination`, `email`, `phone`, `budget` go to top-level indexed columns; everything else lands in `requirements` JSONB. Leads land as `PENDING_REVIEW` until admin approves.

data.message: Thanks! Your inquiry has been received and is being reviewed.

post.summary: Create an ADMIN user (SUPER_ADMIN only)
post.description: New admin is auto-activated and email-verified.

409.description: Email or phone already in use

post.summary: Approve vendor's KYC
post.description: Approves KYC and re-activates the vendor's account atomically. Approval email sent. Requires `kycStatus = SUBMITTED`.

approval.message: Your KYC is approved. You now have full marketplace access.

post.summary: Reject vendor's KYC
post.description: Rejects with a reason, re-activates the vendor's account so they can log back in and fix issues, sends rejection email.

example.reason: PAN number does not match company name. Please re-upload.

get.summary: Get current KYC status + documents + approval summary
get.description: Returns `kycStatus`, the KYC payload, every verified document, and an `approval` block that tells the frontend exactly where the vendor stands.

approval.message: Your application is under review. We will email you once an admin approves your account.

post.summary: Submit the KYC wizard (final step)
post.description:
Persists company-level fields and flips `kycStatus → SUBMITTED`.

**Side effects on success:**
- `User.isActive = false` (vendor locked out until admin decides)
- All refresh tokens revoked
- Vendor appears in admin review queue

Requires PAN to be third-party-verified.

approval.message: Your application is under review. We will email you once an admin approves your account.

400.description: Validation failed or terms not accepted

403.description: KYC already approved or already submitted

post.summary: Verify PAN via Surepass
post.description:
Real-time PAN verification via Surepass `/pan/pan`. Marks `thirdPartyVerified=true`.

**Idempotent:** if the same PAN is already verified for this vendor, returns cached result with `alreadyVerified: true` — NO Surepass credits consumed.

AlreadyVerified.summary: Second call — cached, no credits used

422.description: Surepass rejected (number not found in records)

post.summary: Save GSTIN (format-only validation, no third-party API)
post.description:
Format-only validation. Surepass is NOT called — saves credits. Marks `thirdPartyVerified=true` but with `thirdPartyProvider: "FORMAT_ONLY"` so admins know to manually verify the uploaded certificate.

**Idempotent:** same number returns cached result.

example.message: GSTIN saved. Admin will verify the uploaded certificate.

post.summary: Save CIN (format-only validation, no third-party API)
post.description:
Format-only validation, no Surepass call. Same pattern as GSTIN. Marks `thirdPartyVerified=true` with provider `"FORMAT_ONLY"`.

**Idempotent:** same number returns cached result.

post.summary: Step 1 of Aadhaar — start DigiLocker session
post.description:
Calls Surepass `/digilocker/initialize` and returns a DigiLocker SDK URL. The frontend opens this URL; the user authenticates on DigiLocker (UIDAI OTP handled there). DigiLocker redirects back to the URL configured in `SUREPASS_REDIRECT_URL`. The frontend's callback page then fires `/aadhaar/complete`.

**Idempotent:** if Aadhaar is already verified for this vendor, returns `alreadyVerified: true` and SKIPS the Surepass call (frontend can skip DigiLocker too).

value.message: DigiLocker verification initiated. Open the redirect URL to complete it.

post.summary: Step 2 of Aadhaar — fetch verified Aadhaar from Surepass
post.description:
Called from the frontend callback page AFTER the user finishes DigiLocker. Backend uses the parked `client_id` to call Surepass `GET /digilocker/download-aadhaar/<client_id>` and persists the verified Aadhaar data.

No OTP is passed — DigiLocker owns the OTP step end-to-end.

sessionId.description: Returned by /aadhaar/initiate; persists across the DigiLocker redirect (frontend stores in localStorage).

400.description: Missing or invalid sessionId, or no pending Aadhaar session

401.description: Invalid session, expired, or DigiLocker not yet completed

get.summary: Browse active leads in teaser mode
get.description:
Returns active leads. For leads the vendor has NOT unlocked, `email` and `phone` are masked (e.g., `tr****@example.com`, `********1332`). For unlocked leads, full contact details are returned.

Requires APPROVED KYC.

403.description: KYC not approved or vendor deactivated

post.summary: Unlock a lead — debits the credit wallet atomically
post.description: Atomic Prisma transaction with two CAS-style updates: (1) reserve a slot on the lead, (2) debit the wallet. Any failure aborts everything. After success, returns the FULL unmasked lead.

example.message: Lead unlocked. Contact details are now visible.

value.message: You have already unlocked this lead.
This lead has just been fully claimed.
This lead is no longer available.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, or expired access token

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but role not allowed for this endpoint

OtpMetadata.description: Metadata returned alongside any endpoint that sends an OTP — lets the frontend render countdown timers and disable resend buttons accurately.

ApprovalSummary.description: Frontend-friendly summary of vendor's KYC approval state. Derived from kycStatus.

password.description: Must include uppercase, lowercase, and a digit.

token.description: Google ID token (JWT) from the frontend's Google Sign-In flow.

role.description: Required only for brand-new account creation.

VerifyResetOtpRequest.description: Used in step 2 of the password-reset 3-step wizard. Validates the OTP without consuming it.

companyType.description: Accepts canonical enum values or verbose labels like "Proprietorship Firm".

budget.description: Empty string → null. Numeric → INR amount.
